name: evidence_ladder
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: one row per (approved drug, direction): automated rung from approval, tumour-context trial and paediatric evidence (5 = approved AND context trial AND paediatric label-or-study; 4 = context trial; else 1), and — only where the card folder carries an evidence.tsv — a curated rung from it (a PMID read by a person, rung 2 cell / 3 in vivo); rung = max of the two, both printed. A card with no evidence.tsv is graded on the automated rungs alone and every curated_rung is empty, which is the honest reading for an uncurated card, not a zero. Flags name anti-directions (card moa_pattern), standard of care, curated-only and unverified approval

inputs.name: openfda
inputs.role: current US drug labelling, the second evidence of approval
inputs.sha256_scope: roll-up: sha256 over the sorted sha256 digests of every cached reply body this build read from this API. A public API has no single byte stream to hash; this value is reproducible from the cache and changes when any reply changes.
inputs.known_gap: this API states no release or version in its replies, so the field is null rather than a date copied from the run.

patient_data: none. Public API replies only - gene symbols, drug names, trial ids and citations. Nothing here was derived from the callset, and no genomic position appears in any row by construction.
